extension.news: 2026-11-20 [B]- Summary of v2.1.2 (see Tools > Changelog for the detail):[/B] * Vidnest uses the current player key. Alfa, Beta, Lamda, and Prime follow the paths the player uses now * HydraHD uses hydrahd.gd. The older names still redirect there * VidBolt uses the site resolve API first. HdHub uses the CineWave referer and a TMDb fallback * 2Embed uses vidsrc.buzz for movies and TV. Vidrock keeps Atlas and Astra. Jupiter and MovieUniverse are on * A new series is scraped as the older show of the same name when that episode's air date is still listed * Quality labels use the filename, API field, or hoster button when those already say 4K or 1080p
